## Three-Layer Cascade

Project sets darkly, `_metadata.yml` sets flatly, this document overrides
to vapor + custom SCSS. Vapor (#170229) and the custom marker (#f0e0d0) must
appear; the document-level theme wins over both directory and project levels.
